findings.title: Accepted remote private mode left the visible PGN replay uncleared
evidence: The settings helper assigned overlayMode before the periodic caller compared remote.mode with overlayMode; the comparison therefore failed to run updatePrivateOverlayLabel.
The already rendered 64-square board and imported PGN remained visible after privateOverlayRequested() became true.
The independent reproduction invokes the production registered settings interval without invoking the separate health interval.
findings.caller_callee: settings interval (old line 695) -> syncOverlaySettings (251-269) -> mode assignment; skipped updatePrivateOverlayLabel (249) -> hideBrowserHints (220-228) -> clearReplay (431-437)
findings.fix: Both POST and GET fallback accept settings via adoptOverlaySettings, which synchronously applies privacy and increments the replay invalidation revision before returning. The interval compares against the captured previous mode.
findings.independent_tests: 25 viewer Node tests passed, including POST, GET fallback, pending PGN response and older-settings-version controls.
findings.real_dom_status: Two parameterized real-DOM cases read, not executed by this reviewer; Chromium socket restriction remains open.

findings.title: An old queued native frame survived hidden-tab restore and acquired a fresh generation
findings.source_at_repro: features worktree parent 578f2c4ab44aa3d9b98db62d08e0352572521d3a with the initial two DOM P1 fixes
findings.caller_callee: paint -> sendVisualUpdate queues frame while owner token is absent; hideForInactive/restore->invalidate->clearRemoteOverlay returns before clearing queue; later sendOverlayMode flushes queued data through visualPayload using the new analysisSerial
reproduction: Start private overlay sync and hold the /api/overlay/claim response.
Paint a legal start-position result so pendingVisualUpdate contains the e2e4 arrow.
Hide the tab, change the synthetic board to the position after e4, and restore visibility.
Release the lease. Production code emits /api/overlay/update with the old start FEN, e2e4 arrow, visible=true and generation=1 even though the current board is AFTER_E4.
findings.fix: clearRemoteOverlay synchronously drops pendingVisualUpdate before its owner-token early return. Both hidden-tab clear and restore invalidation therefore remove unclaimed frames.
findings.negative_control: Existing ordinary private-overlay lease/heartbeat and geometry tests continued passing.

findings.title: A hidden-tab restore repainted cached arrows after the board changed
findings.discovered_by: Feature agent; independently reviewed and GREEN-tested by BUGS_SECURITY
findings.caller_callee: visibility/focus -> restoreOverlayAfterVisibility -> old cached show/paint; the cached result bypassed a fresh board tick
findings.fix: Restore now invalidates cached results and active analysis requests synchronously before awaiting private-mode sync, then schedules a fresh tick.

findings.title: Accepted remote private mode left page-owned arrows visible while native claim was pending
findings.discovered_by: Feature agent; independently reviewed and GREEN-tested by BUGS_SECURITY
findings.caller_callee: syncPrivateMode -> syncOverlayMode -> syncOverlayPreference -> sendOverlayMode awaited claim/mode; old adoption updated the preference without clearing existing SVG
findings.fix: Both POST and GET fallback invalidate the page display immediately after accepting the changed mode, before requesting native lease or mode IO.

pgn_http_parser.result: No additional confirmed finding after SEC-002
checks: POST /api/pgn/replay belongs to PROTECTED_PATHS and BODY_REQUIRED; host/origin and capability/instance validation precede the route.
HistoryRequest forbids extra fields and bounds pgn to 1..40000 characters; shared body reading bounds request bytes.
The endpoint calls only build_replay through the error boundary and does not mutate SESSION or call model/engine code.
Parser rejects custom FEN/SetUp, nonstandard variants, parser-reported illegal/ambiguous moves, null moves, more than one game and mainlines longer than 1013 plies.
Returned positions are generated by pushing the accepted legal mainline; headers and comments are omitted and parser diagnostics do not disclose supplied PGN or FEN.
python-chess is intentionally tolerant of unrecognized tokens; documentation accurately avoids promising a strict PGN syntax certificate.

viewer.result: SEC-002 found and independently verified fixed
checks: File input is byte-bounded before read; PGN text is character-bounded before authenticated local POST.
Replay UI uses textContent and validated FEN/square construction; game data is not stored in localStorage.
Clearing, replacement, private mode and capture lifecycle invalidate pending import replies via revision and abort checks.
A replay requires normal/share mode with live capture inactive, including pending capture start/stop states.
No inference, capture start, live session import or external request is performed by the replay route.

performance.result: No confirmed correctness or security finding
checks: SAN formatting is deferred to the already selected mate result, using each move's correct parent board.
Candidate ordering, search bounds, return text and board-copy ownership remain unchanged.
The benchmark resolves an explicit commit, loads only the relevant function AST and compares output plus board state; alternating paired measurements exclude input construction.
The optional differential artifact contains 20 synthetic histories; its claimed output/board equality is artifact evidence, not a new independent 20-case execution.
performance.timing_claim_scope: Synthetic local tactical scan only. No claim for end-to-end model, GPU or Stockfish latency. No additional long benchmark was run.

userscript_fixes.result: All three confirmed lifecycle/privacy issues independently verified fixed; no open blocking finding in reviewed paths
checks: The invalidation cancels active analysis and increments analysisSerial before the async restore handshake.
Page-owned SVG and HUD are removed synchronously when a remote private mode is accepted via POST or GET fallback.
Queued native frames are dropped even before a lease exists, so later claim completion cannot publish stale data with a fresh generation.
All four new behavioral cases pass, including POST/GET transports; ordinary existing mode, heartbeat and geometry checks also pass.
